text:
maria: incident-bot just paged on high gpu queue growth in eu-west-1, seeing sustained 4x increase since v2.3 rollout 🤦
incident-bot: 🔔 Incident created: INC-2026-0315 | gpu-pool-exhaustion | Priority: P1. Alerting: @oncall, @eng-sre. Initial metric: gpu_queue_depth > 1200 for 10m.
aj: looking. seeing a sharp spike in kv-cache memory pressure and context length distribution shifted — lots of 16k+ requests now.
maria: confirmed. rollout of model v2.3 started 10:10 UTC; traffic ramped at 10:12. latency SLOs breached around 10:18.
leo: tagging in from oncall. can you paste the dashboard link and the top affected pools?
maria: https://console.redwood/ops/dashboards/INC-2026-0315
maria: affected pools: eu-west-gpu-pool-4 (hot), eu-west-burst-1 (saturated), fallback pools showing high throttles.
leo: OK. are we seeing queueing / throttles at infra layer or at runtime scheduler?
aj: runtime scheduler. logs show "enqueue_req: queue_size=1347, throttle=true" across multiple hosts. KV cache warmup is causing long cold paths; context KV retention per session doubled due to model change.
nina: quick customer impact check — which orgs hit 5xx/timeout? sam, can you run the query?
sam: running. Querying ingress logs for 5xx and 504s between 10:15-10:30... results: 9 enterprise tenants showing >1% error rate, 32k requests timed out, top impacted: shoplane-prod, assistly, docsight-enterprise.
leo: thanks. severity confirmed. mitigation options: 1) rollback v2.3 rollout, 2) emergency scale up GPU pool, 3) throttle context length at router, 4) enable degraded model variant (v2.2-quant) fallback.
maria: need quick win — can we toggle routing to prefer v2.2 for eu-west via AB test switch?
aj: yes, feature-flagged. I can flip traffic to v2.2 for 50% in 60s, then 100% if metrics improve. also can increase gpu-pool replica by +4 immediately but will take ~3m to provision.
leo: do the feature flag first. aj please execute, then run the scaling in parallel if queue doesn't drop.
aj: flipping flag now -> set_flag rollout.v2.3.eu_west = 0.0 (previously 1.0)
aj: flag applied. routing should start draining v2.3 instances. monitoring...
incident-bot: Scaling action queued: scale eu-west-gpu-pool-4 +4 replicas (requested by aj). Estimated completion: 3m.
maria: logs show fall-through requests to v2.2 quant variant bouncing latency down already.
leo: check queue depth and throttles.
aj: pulling metrics... queue_depth: 10:22 1347 -> 10:26 412 -> 10:30 98. throttle_rate: 72% -> 18% -> 2%.
leo: nice. low hanging fruit worked. keep scale request running but hold off if not needed.
maria: customer impact alert draft: "Intermittent timeouts and higher latency for a subset of customers in EU region from 10:15-10:28 UTC during v2.3 rollout. Mitigated by rolling traffic to fallback model and autoscale. No data exfiltration. Postmortem to follow." Thoughts?
nina: add which customers affected and ETA for root cause. also mention post-deploy model config change (kv-window default) increased per-session KV retention.
sam: noticed a lot of long-context interactive sessions from assistly test orgs — probably test harness sending long histories; flagged their org to reach out.
leo: ok. next steps: 1) keep throttles monitored for 30m, 2) schedule rollback analysis of v2.3 config for kv retention, 3) run a canary with v2.3 but with kv-cache-size limit to reproduce before re-rollout.
aj: capturing runbook steps in the incident ticket. I'm also adding an emergency rate-limit rule at the ingress to cap context_length to 12k for now (will drop tokens beyond limit) — applying.
aj: ingress patch applied: ```
patch: ingress/filters/context-length-cap
max_context_tokens: 12000
mode: truncate
```
maria: can we add a temporary prefork pool to absorb warmups so KV warmup doesn't stall main pool?
leo: cloud quota tight today; preforking +4 might be fine if cost approved. hold until we see if scale completes.
incident-bot: Note: autoscaler observed max_replicas limit=6 for eu-west-gpu-pool-4; scale requests beyond limit will queue. (policy id: autoscale-policy-9)
leo: aha — autoscaler cap prevented full scale which worsened queue. open action: request temporary policy bump to 10 replicas.
maria: pinging infra team to bump cap. @aj can you file the emergency infra request and include justification.
aj: filed infra request #INFRA-8860: request bump autoscale cap eu-west-gpu-pool-4 from 6 -> 10. included metrics and customer impact. Assigning to infra oncall.
sam: infra acknowledged, ETA 12m. If they can't confirm, we have fallback: continue routing to v2.2 and keep ingress cap.
leo: good. capture customers impacted and notify CS to contact top customers proactively.
nina: I'll draft customer comms: impacted window and mitigation, offer credit if SLA breached. sharing draft in #customer-alerts for review.
maria: status update: queue stable at ~80, throttle <2%, latency trending to baseline. I'm going to mark this as mitigated but keep P1 until autoscale cap bump confirmed and postmortem created.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0315 status changed to mitigated by maria at 10:34 UTC. Assigned to leo for postmortem.
leo: taking postmortem. action items assigned: aj -> revert/adjust kv retention in v2.3 and re-run canary, infra -> confirm autoscaler cap increase or rationale, devex -> add warnings for model rollout that change kv retention, product -> block auto-rollouts until canary with kv metrics passes.
maria: thanks all. will hand off to leo for the deep dive. leaving thread.
leo: copying notes to the PM and scheduling postmortem for 10:00 UTC tomorrow. closing Slack thread for live ops. :white_check_mark:
